notes.title: New Game from Antoni Games: Rogue Party 2
notes.content:
Well I finally did it. I made the leap of faith from XNA to UNITY game development and here's the result: Rogue Party 2! Thank you for buying my games and I hope you find this new addition to be as much fun as I had making it.

Steam link:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1274980/Rogue_Party_2/

Your Turn Hero

The golem's scream was lost in the myriad of crumbling dungeon passageways. Nailliv was already in the process of making the next one, so the loss didn't bother him in the slightest. He will stop at nothing to achieve his goal, killing Sargon and discovering the secrets of portal magic.
You come to life suddenly. The loosely constructed essence of a fallen warrior within the cold stones of a golem.
All you know is your current quest, and so you set out on your journey.
Throughout the first dungeon you find a heavy sword and fire staff with magical properties that grant you life stealing powers. As you slay scores of enemies, you accumulate gold, potions and more items to aid in your adventure. The warrior spirit eminates from your reanimated body and you continue to grow in power.
At last you reach him, Sargon, only to fall before his magic. As you crumble and the warrior spirit leaves you, your last thought is the hope that the next golem (or golems) will succeed where you have failed...

Features
* 1 to 4 Player Co-Op adventures
- Scaling difficulty, but if players stick together they will have a slight advantage in multiplayer games.
- Potions can be thrown at friends to help (or hurt them because it's hilarious).
- Boss fights incentivize teamwork, especially on hard mode when additional enemies are spawned with the boss.
* Randomized Levels, Items, Enemies, Bosses
- Every one of the game's 20 levels is randomly selected so your experience will be different every playthrough.
- Enemies are chosen from a random pool and placed on random spawn points.
- Chests and their contents, likewise, are chosen from a random pool of items and placed on random spawn points.
- Bosses are chosen from pools just like Enemies and Items. There are 4 different bosses to choose from for each Boss fight available.

* Dynamic Potion System
- Eight randomized potions chosen each game from 17 types (two are always healing).
- Each potion is learned for the remainder of the game after using them on yourself, an enemy or an ally.
- A person in town will sell you potions to help offset your bad luck finding them.
* Item "Prefix" System
- Some items will roll a "Prefix" with bonus affects. These stack up to three times with other items that have the same prefix.
- Example: "Shocking: 33% chance to launch lightning on hit." If you had two of these it would be a 66% chance.
- 32 Prefixes can randomly be rolled onto your items.
- Procs from Prefix items can happen from other Prefixes.
- Planning the Prefixes you want and changing your plan based on what you randomly find is half the fun!
* Elite Item System
- Defeating some bosses will unlock elite weapons and armor.
- Once unlocked, these items will have a low chance of appearing in chests throughout the game.
- Elite Items can also roll random Prefixes.

* New Gem System
- Each boss you defeat drops a gem that can be enchanted with a Prefix.
- You get to choose from 4 random Prefixes which one goes on your gem.
- These Gem Prefixes stack with whatever is on your other items.
- Dying in multiplayer will not reset your Gems.

* New Ghost System
- In Rogue Party 2, the death system has been completely overhauled.
- Until a player finds the exit or defeats the current boss, you will be a Ghost.
- As a Ghost, players can knockback enemies every few seconds.
- Use this ability to help or troll your friends.

* New Town System
- You are no longer on your own in Rogue Party 2.
- After every boss, you will have a chance to revisit the town.
- Rain will heal you.
- Cookie will enchant your gems.
- Nailliv will sell you potions.
- Evalyn has upgrades for your items for sale.

* New Hard Mode
- Alternate Ending.
- Enhanced enemy AI and upgraded combat abilities.
- Unique rewards for beating Hard Mode.
- Epic final multi-stage boss fight.

Note from the Creator:
Rogue Party 2 was a labor of love by one indie developer. Thank you to everyone who supported me in making this game!

notes.title: Blocked and Loaded Launch Event
notes.content:
We had 4 player PVP matches, open world exploring for loot, epic boss battles and a whole lot of fun!

On the bug list side there were a handful of new ones that needed to be squashed and I worked as fast as I could to do just that. Your feedback was exceptional in this regard as well as your willingness to test out features.

Enhancements were made to the game already, including a nice floating name feature above people's heads.

I'm hard at work at level 2, but if you'd like me to jump in at some point just send me a message.


Thank you all for a very inspiring launch day!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/772270/Blocked_and_Loaded/

notes.title: Next Up: One Night You're Crazy!
notes.content:
Thank you for playing my games all these years and helping support me in this fantastic journey of game development. If you enjoyed the "Real Life" style horror games I've created in the past, then you will fall in love with One Night You're Crazy. Yes, you can play as the big bad wolf and tear other players apart.

Store Page Link:

notes.title: UPDATE COMPLETE!
notes.content:
------------------ Patch Notes -----------------

Based on your awesome feedback I have already finished the first update for Zombie Town!

The day night cycle is now 20 minutes long.

ONLY IN GAME TIME COUNTS.

Zombies now start off doing 6 damage on day one and scale up to 12 damage over time.

Bleeding and Infected characters have a chance to heal at midnight based on your medical facility level and whether you have a doctor.


------------------ Coming Soon -----------------

Rare items that will instantly heal bleeding wounds and infections.
Additional special item bonuses that rarely get applied to items you find.
More missions!

Please give feedback and I will improve the game! Thank you! Also we could desperately use some reviews!

notes.title: Bug Fixes and Incoming Updates
notes.content:
There was a bug where players with strange characters in their names caused lobbies to crash. It has been resolved (you need latest update to see the fix).


Regarding updates, I will be looking into making the day/night cycle fairer to those people who play less between sessions.

Infections and Bleeding can be cured overnight if you have medicine, but I am working on a solution for allowing you to cure either with things like adrenaline or medical kits. Perhaps it will be a better chance based on your medical area's level and if you have a doctor.

Your feedback is extremely helpful. I am especially interested in what kinds of missions you'd like me to add.

Thank you!

notes.title: Launch Time!
notes.content:
For the zombies it might be 'lunch' time ;-)

Game is live and I'm available for feedback, bug fixes, etc. Please flood the discussion area with things you'd like to see improved and our two man team will get to work right away.

Once all post release bugs are fixed I will look into adding more missions and an exciting PvP mode. Stay tuned and please give us feedback on all aspects of the game.

There's nothing quite like creating a game and if it weren't for people like you we couldn't do this. Thank YOU!
